prompt:
TRUE chunky pixel art static asset sheet only. Three 8x8 logical items in an exact 3-column by 1-row grid, rendered large as crisp square Cells, separated by two full magenta #FF00FF logical gutter Cells. Flat magenta #FF00FF keyed background outside and around every item. Overall canvas aspect exactly 3.5:1. No labels, numbers, margins, anti-aliasing, blur, gradients, or dithering.

Subject: three loose chunks of cyan crystal ore broken out of a mine face and dropped on the ground. Same material as a cyan crystal seam in warm dark plum-brown rock: angular shard geometry, neutral upper-left local highlight, warm shadow underneath. Each chunk is a compact lump that sits flat on the ground with a clear silhouette - magenta must surround each chunk on all four sides so it reads as a separate object, not as a filled tile.

Item 1 "chunk-a": a single blocky angular shard, widest at the base, one bright highlight facet.
Item 2 "chunk-b": two fused smaller shards leaning together, a notch between them at the top.
Item 3 "chunk-c": a squat rounded lump with a chipped upper corner and more attached plum-brown rock than the other two.

The three must be distinguishable from each other by silhouette alone at native scale. Cyan is confined to crystal Cells - do not paint a glow or recolor the ground.

No characters, no tools, no pickaxe, no cart, no text, no UI, no borders, no vignette.
